description: Agent Commitments: submit commitment records to read for whether each can be verified: each commitment with its id, the commitment as written, read for hedges such as try to, hopefully or if possible and for timing such as soon or when possible, the deliverable, read for activity wording such as look into or help with, the owner by name, the date it is due, the event it is due on such as when the contract is signed, and how to tell done from not done, read for wording such as when it looks good. The signed report gives every commitment with its parts, the vague wording read from each and its status as specific, deliverable_unclear, owner_unnamed, timing_missing, done_test_missing, timing_vague, done_test_vague, hedged or unconfirmed, counts the specific, owned, dated and tested commitments, and lists every vague word found, and names commitments that cannot be verified: a deliverable that is missing or worded as activity, no owner or an owner named only as a group or a placeholder such as the team or TBD, no date or event, and no way to tell done from not done; then timing no one can check, a done test left to opinion and a hedged commitment, with the fix for each. This reads the agent’s own commitments as written: missing terms and acceptance tests in a proposed deal are wever_negotiation-terms-check, and the accountable person per outcome is wever_ownership-map-brief. Verdict commitments_unverifiable, commitment_specificity_gaps, commitment_specificity_unverified or commitments_specific. POST /api/commitment-specificity-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.

commitment.description: The commitment as written, read for hedges such as try to or hopefully.

done_when.description: How to tell done from not done, such as the deck is in the shared folder.

due.description: When it is due, as a date.

id.description: The commitment id, such as c1.

trigger.description: The event it is due on, such as when the data lands.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_commitment-specificity-check
title: Commitment specificity check
